**Description

**Factbird is a manufacturing intelligence suite that turns real-time production data into actionable insights. Our plug-and-play hardware and AI-powered SaaS solution help manufacturers cut downtime, improve efficiency and reduce waste. We are around 100 people across Europe and the US, growing more than 50% year over year. We have just partnered with the private equity firm Verdane to strengthen our product roadmap and expand our reach even further.

We have built a solid Revenue Operations foundation, with HubSpot as our CRM, BigQuery as our data warehouse, and Power BI and Claude for reporting that the leadership team and the board rely on. Now we want to take the next step. We are looking for a Revenue Operations Manager who doesn't just keep the engine running, but tells us where to steer it.

This is a role for someone who looks at our numbers and asks "so what?" Which segments should we double down on? Where is the funnel leaking? Which investments will pay back? What can we do even better? You will help answer those questions and make sure the answers lead to action.

**The role

**You will own Revenue Operations across the full customer journey, from the first marketing touch to sales, onboarding, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to unify the processes, technology, and data behind our revenue teams so that growth becomes more predictable, transparent, and scalable.

You will be based at our office at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, report to the CFO, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and the senior leadership team. You will lead our Business Intelligence Analyst, who owns the data warehouse, the data pipelines, and the Power BI dashboards.

You will thrive here if you combine a commercial mindset with analytical rigor, and you enjoy turning a messy question into a clear recommendation that a leadership team can act on.

**What You'll Do

**Planning and GTM

• Turn performance, customer, and market data into clear recommendations: where to invest, which segments and industries to prioritize, and what isn't working.

• Support commercial planning with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, including targets, quotas, and capacity planning.

• Support sales leadership on territory design, lead routing, and pipeline coverage.

Data and Intelligence

• Develop the commercial KPIs that matter across the funnel, such as pipeline, conversion, win rates, CAC, churn, and net revenue retention, and understand the data behind it.

• Own the monthly commercial performance reporting for the leadership team and present the story and learnings behind the numbers.

• Lead deep-dive analyses, such as ICP and industry performance, win/loss and churn drivers, and recommend corrective actions.

• Lead and develop our Business Intelligence Analyst: set priorities, goals, and development plans.

Best in Class Processes

• Map our processes from lead to renewal, find the bottlenecks, and fix them together with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

• Design workflows and hand-offs that cut admin time and improve data quality for Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

Technology and AI

• Foster the adoption of AI across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success: connect AI assistants to our CRM and data, and build AI-powered workflows for enrichment, lead scoring and reporting. AI-powered tools in our current stack include Gong, Amplemarket, Claude and Dreamdata.

• Measure the impact of AI and automation on productivity and pipeline.

Revenue Funnel Pursuit

• Give the revenue teams the insights, tools and cadences they need at every stage of the funnel, from demand generation to renewal and expansion.

• Support Marketing on attribution, intent data and campaign reporting.

• Support Customer Success with health, churn-risk and expansion insights.

Project Management

• Plan and deliver cross-functional revenue projects from scope to measurable impact.

• Lead the change management that comes with new processes and tools, so they stick.

**What We're Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded problem solver who uses data to drive decisions and create value. You understand what drives growth in a B2B business, you are comfortable in front of a leadership team, and you are hands-on enough to get into HubSpot yourself.

The ideal background

• 5 to 7 years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, commercial analytics, strategy or management consulting, or a similar role.

• Experience from a B2B SaaS or tech scale-up, where you have seen what drives growth up close.

• A proven track record of turning data into insights and recommendations that leaders acted on.

• Strong analytical skills: you may have been a Business Intelligence Analyst in the past. You are definitely at home with funnel metrics, unit economics and forecasting, and you can build a model in Excel or a BI tool.

• Solid HubSpot experience and you will need to be confident as its Super Admin.

• Curiosity about AI, and practical experience using it to automate work or get more out of data.

• Clear communication in English, written and spoken, at leadership and board level.

How you work

• You think like a business owner and always ask what a number means for growth.

• You work autonomously, take ownership, and see what could be better before anyone asks. You help the teams around you turn those ideas into real improvements.

• You build trust across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, and you can challenge with facts.

• You enjoy coaching others and want to develop the analyst on your team.

• You like structure, but you are happy to build it where it doesn't exist yet.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams - and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity

**The Clients & Industries (C&I) Revenue Planning Lead will have overall global oversight and leadership of the Global C&I Revenue Planning Team within the Enablement & Technology domain. The role will team closely with Global and Region Clients & Industries Leadership and domains on cross-functional initiatives and translate EY’s strategic priorities into the revenue planning business process.

The role will lead the continued evolution of global sales and revenue planning, strengthening the processes, governance and capabilities that connect account-level growth ambitions with regional and global business priorities. Working across markets, service lines and strategic growth areas, the role will help translate growth ambitions into actionable sales and revenue plans, focusing on topline growth, where and how the business will grow. It does not own P&L, financial forecasting, budgeting or expense planning, which remain Finance responsibilities.

Serve as the primary relationship lead to Global and Region leadership, connecting sales and revenue planning priorities with broader business objectives, enabling alignment, strengthening adoption, and accelerating decisions.

This includes active management of all sales and revenue planning business processes globally, aligned to and informed by evolving business needs. The role will collaborate with teams to identify and enable opportunities to use AI and advanced technologies to improve planning effectiveness, decision support, process efficiency and user adoption across the revenue planning lifecycle. The role will also have a hands-on delivery role across the range of sales and revenue planning activities.

The role will be responsible for performance management of the Revenue Planning Team, including LEAD counselor responsibilities and the integration of GDS resource capability.

As a key member of the Enablement & Technology domain, the role will collaborate on a broader set of Global Clients & Industries priorities and may act as sponsor for agreed strategic initiatives.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**Some or all the below will be applicable depending on the scope and team alignment of the role.

• 
Sales & Revenue Planning

• 
Continue to build, refine, and manage sales and revenue planning

• 
Implement and maintain consistency of sales and revenue planning governance globally

• 
Establish trusted, long-term relationships with senior leaders to understand their priorities and translate them into coordinated revenue planning actions

• 
Shape and sustain strategic stakeholder alignment across Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation, Industry, and Client Excellence, providing strategic leadership and influence to align cross-functional priorities to enable a consistent global revenue planning process

• 
Participate in and contribute to efforts to ensure consistency of integrated planning processes and protocols across Clients & Industries, Finance, Regions, Services Lines, Growth & Innovation, and IT

• 
Process improvement

• 
Guide the evolution of revenue planning toward a process to enhance strategic decision- making

• 
Collaborate with Finance to identify relevant, consistent revenue planning, analysis for senior stakeholders (i.e., GE, GPG, GMIC, Clients & Industries Leadership)

• 
Operationalize and implement on a consistent basis; identify trends and issues and present recommendations as warranted

• 
Leverage AI and advanced technologies to streamline revenue planning processes, improve data quality and insight generation, and increase efficiency, accuracy and decision support

• 
Effective teaming

• 
Deliver inclusive and trusted leadership and coaching at all levels to ensure all Revenue Planning team members achieve their highest potential both individually and collectively

• 
Manage, mentor and counsel Revenue Planning team members, as appropriate

• 
Leverage and elevate GDS resource capability across the Clients & Industries revenue planning landscape

• 
Manage Clients & Industries and other EY stakeholder relationships - Clients & Industries pillar leaders, Finance, Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation - and identify opportunities for effective collaboration

• 
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:

• 
Apply in-depth knowledge of the business and resources, leveraging relationships, communications and operational effectiveness to anticipate, drive and deliver complex revenue planning

• 
Provide strategic revenue planning insight and guidance to leadership

• 
Possess a high level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability

• 
Convert planning data or abstract concepts into sharp, compelling management information reporting

• 
Create and implement timelines related to project deliverables, assign tasks, drive their completion and manage sponsor/stakeholder expectations of the outcomes

• 
Manage highly complex relationships with multiple stakeholders

• 
Make decisions regarding project resource and funding needs

• 
Supervision Responsibilities:

• 
Lead, coach and develop the Revenue Planning team

• 
Develop a culture of success by leading and driving the execution of high-performing, diverse and inclusive talent management (hiring, developing, assessing, etc)

• 
LEAD Reviewer responsibilities and provision of mentoring and regular feedback

• 
Develop and maintain metrics on team performance, providing regular feedback in LEAD and publicizing the teams’ contributions to leadership and other relevant stakeholders

• 
Instil high performing teaming principles

• 
Operate with high degree of independency and autonomy

**Skills And Attributes For Success

**

• In-depth knowledge of the EY business and working in a global partnership

• Strong influencing and consensus-building capability in a complex, matrixed organization where success depends on partnership rather than direct authority

• Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility quickly across functions, geographies, and leadership levels

• Experience in large transformation programs within a global environment and/or successfully transforming business functions. This includes demonstrated change leadership skills around disruption and increasing business agility, innovation and adoption

• High level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability, a wide sphere of influence and a broad-based network are expected

• Financial acumen with demonstrable ability to analyze business reporting and develop business insights

• Demonstrates technology acumen, comfortable with AI and automation

• Proven track record of leading global virtual teams

• Demonstrated drive, determination and resilience, and track record of being able to overcome barriers and achieve results

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with a global mindset and ability to communicate and work effectively across culture

• Understanding of and desire to strive for technical excellence and commercial impact

• Demonstrated experience working at a senior level in a fast-moving, client-driven environment

• Strong executive presence and ability to build and sustain stakeholder relationships at the highest levels of the firm with the ability to quickly establish personal credibility and influence

• Resilient, agile, and pragmatic under pressure

**To qualify for the role, you must have:

**

• Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent qualification required

• 10-12 years of experience leading complex, large-scale transformation initiatives, preferably within sales, commercial, finance or enterprise planning functions.

**Ideally, you should also be prepared for the following:

**

• Travel may be required from time to time to complete assignments and meet with organizational leaders and stakeholders

• Flexibility in working hours to accommodate volume of work and multiple time zones as needed

**What We Offer You

Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges.At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $155,300 to $283,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

• Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

On behalf of HydraSpecma, Medarbejderne ApS is looking for a Commercial Development Manager who can turn HydraSpecma’s technical capabilities and industrial platform into market access, customer opportunities and a sustainable business within liquid cooling for data centers.

**Build the market - not just the pipeline

**HydraSpecma is building a strategic business area within Data Center Cooling, and the assignment is deliberately broader than a traditional sales role. You will help determine where HydraSpecma should position itself, which customers and partners matter most, and how technical capabilities can be converted into a scalable commercial offering.

Your initial focus will be the Nordic market. You will map the value chain, create access to relevant decision-makers and turn market dialogue into qualified opportunities, business cases, pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives. Over time, the ambition is to expand into selected EMEA markets as the business develops.

**A role between market, technology and strategy

**You will work across hyperscalers, colocation providers, EPC contractors, system integrators, OEMs and other stakeholders that influence specifications and supplier choices. You are expected to understand how projects are initiated, where decisions are made and how long-term positions are built in technically complex environments.

Internally, you will act as a commercial bridge between the market, senior management and HydraSpecma’s technical specialists. Early success is therefore not measured by revenue alone. It is also measured by whether HydraSpecma gains a clear view of the market, a strong position in the value chain and a qualified pipeline with relevant customers and projects. International travel is a natural part of the role. Your primary workplace will be either Silkeborg or Skjern.

**What will make you successful?

**You are already credible in the data center ecosystem or in a closely related technical infrastructure environment. Experience with hyperscale data centers, liquid cooling, thermal management, critical infrastructure, industrial cooling, HVAC, energy, hydraulics or fluid systems can all be relevant if you bring real market understanding and access.

You combine strategic thinking with practical business development. You are comfortable opening doors yourself, following opportunities closely and creating momentum before every part of the strategy or sales setup is fully defined. Your educational background is less important than your ability to connect market insight, technology and commercial opportunity.

**Why HydraSpecma?

**This is an opportunity to help build a new strategic business area within an established international industrial group. You will have genuine influence on market positioning, commercial priorities and how the business is scaled.

HydraSpecma brings strong technical capabilities within hydraulic systems, hoses, pipes and connectors, electrification and renewable energy. That industrial platform gives you something tangible to build from while you help define where the company can create the strongest long-term position within Data Center Cooling.

**Interested?

**If you know the data center industry and are motivated by creating direction, opening a market and turning technical opportunities into commercial results, we would like to hear from you.

Department: Inspection & Recall

Location: Ballerup, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Director of Inspection & Recalls, you will lead a global team of highly experienced specialists responsible for two areas that are fundamental to our quality organisation; how we prepare for and manage health authority inspections, and how we respond when a Quality Defects arises.

You will build on a strong foundation while helping the team rethink how the work gets done, including where data, automation and AI can make us better, faster and more consistent, and where experience, judgement and human interaction must remain at the centre.

**What You'll Bring

**We are looking for an experienced people leader with a strong track record of leading senior specialists, setting clear direction and creating the conditions for expertise to translate into organisational impact. We imagine you will bring:

• Solid leadership experience, including leading and developing experienced specialists.

• 10+ years of experience and a strong understanding of pharmaceutical quality, regulatory or manufacturing environments, with relevant experience in inspection readiness, recall management or interactions with health authorities such as EMA, DKMA or FDA.

• The ability to turn strategy into clear priorities and meaningful action.

• Sound judgement and remain calm and decisive when navigating risk, competing priorities and complex situations.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior leaders, specialists and external partners.

• Curiosity about how technology, data and AI can improve the way teams work, without losing sight of quality, compliance or human accountability.

**What You'll Do

**You will be responsible for setting a clear direction for the team and create an environment where experienced specialists are empowered to take ownership and succeed. Your responsibilities will include:

• Set a clear direction for Inspection & Recalls and turn the wider Quality strategy into priorities the team can act on.

• Lead, coach and develop experienced specialists, creating clear accountability while giving people the space to use their expertise.

• Keep our approach to inspections strong and consistent across Good Practice areas, from preparation and authority interaction through to responses and follow-up.

• Explore where AI, automation and better use of data can genuinely improve preparedness, insight and efficiency, and help the team adopt new approaches responsibly.

• Make sure we learn from inspections, observations, recalls and near misses, turning those lessons into better ways of working.

**Who You'll Work With

**You will lead the global Inspection & Recalls team and report to the Group Vice President for Quality Innovation & Excellence. You will be part of the Quality Innovation & Excellence Leadership team.The role puts you at the intersection of specialist expertise, senior leadership and external authority interaction.

You will also work closely with the area’s Strategic Advisor, who brings deep specialist and industry expertise. The partnership is an important one: you bring the leadership, direction and accountability that enables that expertise, and the expertise of the wider team, to have impact.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will inherit an experienced team doing work that matters. The opportunity is not to change things for the sake of change, but to ask what great inspection and recall management should look like in the years ahead and help the team get there.

There will be room to challenge established approaches, experiment responsibly and build new capabilities. At the same time, this is a role where reliability matters. You will need to balance transformation with the discipline and judgement required in a global quality organisation.

Salary**:** For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 940,800.00 to 1,448,700.00 DKK, The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead an experienced specialist team while shaping the future of inspection readiness and recall management, apply for the Director, Inspection & Recalls role by 19 November 2026.

Are you passionate about translating strategic priorities into disciplined execution? Do you have extensive experience leading complex, cross-functional projects in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry? If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Project Director, GRAPS.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an experienced and highly structured Associate Project Director to join our GRAPS Enablement & Insights function within Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety.

In this role, you will translate GRAPS priorities into integrated plans and disciplined execution across Global Regulatory Affairs, Global Patient Safety, and key enterprise functions. You will lead strategic and operational initiatives involving multiple functions, geographies, vendors, and systems, while establishing clear governance, decision pathways, performance reporting, and risk management.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine strategic perspective with hands-on project leadership in a global and highly regulated environment. You will work closely with the GRAPS Leadership Team, functional leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen quality, compliance, predictability, and organizational scalability.

You will join the GRAPS team (Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety) and report directly to Jethro Ekuta, Chief Regulatory & Safety Officer, who is based in US.

The position may be based in US or DK, with travel to Ascendis Pharma locations and other business-critical meetings as required.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead assigned GRAPS projects and programs from initiation through closeout, establishing clear scope, objectives, governance, integrated plans, milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, budgets, risk controls, and measurable outcomes

• Partner with GRAPS leaders to translate strategic priorities into roadmaps and sequenced execution plans, while maintaining a consolidated view of the GRAPS project portfolio, including capacity constraints, interdependencies, risks, and decisions requiring leadership attention

• Establish and facilitate fit-for-purpose governance, steering forums, workshops, stage reviews, and decision-making processes, and prepare concise executive dashboards, status reports, decision materials, and recommendations

• Coordinate stakeholders across Regulatory Affairs, Patient Safety, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Quality, IT, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, and external partners, creating clarity around roles, responsibilities, interfaces, and handoffs

• Drive operational excellence and sustainable change by identifying opportunities to standardize, simplify, and scale processes, tools, and ways of working while supporting applicable GxP, regulatory, pharmacovigilance, documentation, training, inspection-readiness, and records-management requirements

You will also provide project-methodology guidance and coaching to workstream leads and more junior project-management colleagues and may coordinate contractors or matrixed team members.

Qualifications and skills

You hold a relevant academic degree, preferably a bachelor's or master's degree in life sciences, business, project management, engineering, or a related discipline, and have at least 8 years of relevant experience from the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or another highly regulated industry.

Furthermore, you have:

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects, programs, or major workstreams involving senior stakeholders, multiple functions, geographies, vendors, or systems

• Strong command of project and program management disciplines, including scope, schedule, governance, resources, budgets, dependencies, risks, issues, change control, and benefits realization

• Working knowledge of drug development and commercialization, preferably combined with experience in Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Patient Safety, Quality, Regulatory Operations, or a closely related function

• Experience creating executive-ready dashboards, status reports, decision materials, and presentations using Microsoft 365 and relevant project-management or reporting tools

• A project-management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent is preferred. Agile or change-management training would be considered an advantage

Key competencies

You have an enterprise mindset and a strong patient focus, combined with sound judgment regarding business, quality, compliance, and reputational risk.

You are highly structured, analytical, and detail-oriented while maintaining a clear focus on strategic objectives and outcomes. You can simplify complexity, frame options, recommend a path forward, and communicate decisions clearly to executive, technical, and operational audiences.

You are an experienced stakeholder manager who can build alignment, create accountability, and influence without formal authority. You are comfortable working with ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and adapting plans when business needs change.

As a person, you are collaborative, inclusive, culturally aware, and effective in a global matrix organization. You demonstrate high integrity, discretion, ownership, and a strong commitment to transparent communication and follow-through.

Travel: 15-25 days a year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma, Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Apply now

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months
